title: Siman 131
section: His Journey to the Land of Israel

segments.he: רָשָׁע, עַל-כֵּן נָפַל עָלָיו פַּחַד גָּדוֹל עָצוּם מְאד בְּלִי שִׁעוּר. וְהִתְחִיל לִצְעק מְאד בִּצְעָקָה מְשֻׁנָּה מְאד וּבָאוּ בִּמְרוּצָה אַנְשֵׁי הַבַּיִת וְרָצוּ לִכְנס לְחַדְרוֹ. וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לִכְנס
segments.en: (3.) When he came from Kamenitz, a young child passed away before him, may she be in peace. He answered and said: "So many and so many, G-d forbid, will die before me because of one movement that makes a distinction between me before my being in Kamenitz and after my having been there. May G-d save us!"
